camera.description: Fixed child-height oblique wide. No camera movement.

start_state: All five together in B, clearly separate. Daddy holds the correct brush; Roshan holds the star sponge. One paper scrap by the playroom/craft thresholds, a reachable web at the base of the column left of the Royal arch, low wall grime near pool/bath, footprints and inert grit at the Royal runner foot remain. Some distant dirt may be occluded, never invent more between cuts.
end_state: Roshan and rainbow friend have noticed the paper; the others share a calm ready-to-help glance. No mess has disappeared yet.
zone: B-wide, Royal stair foot; look across remaining mess
must_move: All five settle after the previous friendship reveal; tools stay safely lowered. Roshan notices the paper and gently indicates it; the tiny rainbow friend looks the same way. Daddy, Eagle and Rumi exchange a warm ready-to-help look. Nothing is cleaned yet.
must_not_move: Fixed screen-B topology: teddy, palette, single blue droplet, three pearls, then open Royal arch with short stairs, left to right; never a coral window on B
Same warm pearl/lavender storybook grade; architecture, emblems, runner and staircase never move or recolor
Roshan plain pink top/lavender tail; Daddy continuous rainbow mer-tail and glasses; Rumi long purple braid/mer-tail; Eagle true bird; no new costumes or limbs

Rainbow friend retains the source cloud-mound, broad spiral ears, red-orange forehead curl, white iridescent glint and pearl feet; total height at same floor depth no more than one quarter of Roshan, pending owner scale approval
Remove only inert litter, webs, wall smears and footprints; living puff creatures are never swept or blasted; no big boss remains
Cleaned zones remain clean; preserve dirt until shown physical contact removes it; no whole-room magical cleanup
sound_intent: Soft castle room tone, one friendly delighted chirrup from the rainbow friend; no dialogue or music baked in.
negative_constraints: No walking through a closed Royal door, missing companion, new corridor/window, giant Puff, glowing four trails, tool swap, cleanup before contact, text or HUD.
